author: Deb6020

title: Great tour of Cordoba!
text: This was a great full-day tour. The first stop at Carmona was well-timed and really pretty. Cordoba was wonderful. Our guide, Merce, was so knowledgeable and just great. And the Mezquita itself was incredible. The day was outstanding.
author: William_R

title: Excellent excursion!
text:
We thoroughly enjoyed our day trip to Cordoba with Merce! She is very enthusiastic and knowledgeable and kept the fairly large group moving along effectively. Whisper boxes were used through much of the trip, which was appreciated. The coach was very comfortable, the rest stops well planned. The side visit to Carmona was just enough to get a brief taste of the city. 
The tour of the Mesquita was excellent! We had been before, a few years ago, but this tour was definitely superior. Highly recommend! Thank you Merce
author: 152brentj

title: Excellent and Informative Trip with Merce
text: This was an excellent tour. Merce was a great tour guide who had excellent knowledge that was easily conveyed across multiple languages (English and Italian). She also infused humor into her explanation which made them easier stay engaged with. She also answered many questions from the group and was not stumped by anything! She also had a great personal touch with the younger member of the group. The guide of the Cordoba Mosque/Cathedral was also excellent and truly one of the most unique places I have seen. title: Amazing sites with great tour leader
text:
I had a wonderful trip.  The tour was run by Naturanda which has numerous offices around Seville.  My hotel was a little bit out of the way so I had to take a bus to get to the meeting point.  While it was scheduled to start at 8:59 AM, the guide was delayed and we only got on the bus around 9:30.  After that everything went smoothly.
Our guide, Fouad, was extremely knowledgeable and helpful.  Since our tour was in both English and French he had to bounce back and forth between both languages which he did masterfully!

title: Perfect!

title: Beautiful!!
text:
A wonderful experience, made even more special by our fantastic guide Merce! ❤️

She accompanied us to discover Cordoba with a passion, kindness, and professionalism that are truly rare. She made us know not only the beauty of the city, but also its history, its traditions, and all those details that make a place truly unforgettable.
